title: Autonomous nightly-loop per-card triage verdict
description: Contract for the LLM triage call in scripts/autonomous-triage.js. Validated by validateTriageResult() in scripts/lib/autonomous-triage-core.js (hand-rolled — keep the two in sync; the colocated test asserts congruence on enums and required keys). One retry echoing the validation errors, then the card is marked failed("triage") — never silently skipped.

size.description: Effort estimate: S ≤30 min single-file, M ≤2h few-files, L = too big for one night (propose a split)

eligible.description: LLM judgment that the work fits Tier-1 constraints (paths, no human decisions, checkable). ANDed with the deterministic pre-filter — the LLM can only narrow, never widen.

checkableDone.description: A concrete runnable command that proves the card is done (e.g. 'node --test scripts/lib/foo.test.mjs'). 'It works' is not acceptable.

splitProposal.description: Required non-empty when size is L: child cards, each a self-contained handoff (notion-brain CARD_TEMPLATE sections; children inherit parent priority/tags/parentId at creation time).

notes.description: Must contain ## Problem, ## Suggested approach, ## Acceptance criteria sections (notion-brain validateCardNotes enforces on create)
